home.title: We run, we swim, we help — and we publish every euro.
home.sub: We organise the Santa Run, winter sea swims and regattas in the Bay of Kotor. The money goes to local families, children and small businesses — and every payment in and out sits in a public ledger.
home.buildNote: This site is under construction. First event: December.
